findings.finding: SignalPolicy.evaluate_probabilities is the single policy chokepoint. Model confidence (probs[1]/[2] from inference) feeds directional confidence via _directional_confidence, then gates run in order: guardian gate, symbol gate, duplicate tick, AI reversal, frequency throttle, exposure limits, HTF/SR alignment, confidence gate, zone quality gate, anti-flip, same-level re-entry lockout. SMC_GOD_MODE (confidence >= ai_zone_confidence_threshold + all SMC conditions) bypasses HTF/SR filters with a 15% confidence penalty. RuleMatrixEngine can independently produce BUY/SELL entries before the model path even executes.

findings.topic: Paper mode vs Live mode boundary
findings.finding: PAPER mode binds PaperMT5Adapter (simulation with deterministic fills, synthetic spread 8-18c gold band, auto-SL/TP execution on every tick). LIVE mode binds DirectMT5Adapter (native MT5 order_send). SHADOW mode KEEPS the live adapter (per live_engine _align_adapter_to_boot_mode: 'SHADOW keeps its live-data (prediction) adapter by contract'). RuntimeModeService.set_execution_mode swaps the adapter on hot-swap and triggers cross-mode state invalidation (session generation bump, price-lock purge, aggregator reseed). PAPER->LIVE swap purges stale paper bars and cached price state.

findings.topic: Model vs Strategy independence — can model BUY while strategy says NO_TRADE?
findings.finding: YES, the model can independently signal BUY while the strategy gates produce NO_TRADE. The model confidence is ONE input to SignalPolicy. Multiple independent gates can convert a BUY-class proposal to NO_TRADE: (1) HTF misalignment (model bullish but h4_trend<0), (2) SR resistance margin fail, (3) confidence gate (model confidence < threshold), (4) zone quality gate, (5) anti-flip, (6) same-level re-entry lockout. The model prediction enters via probs[1] (BUY prob) but the policy can and frequently does emit NO_TRADE despite a BUY signal from inference.
evidence: src/nexus_scalp/signals/policy.py:1044-1048 — BUY rejected at HTF_TREND_FILTER when htf_buy_aligned is False and not smc_god_mode_active (model BUY blocked independently of strategy)

findings.topic: Strategy can trade independently of model
findings.finding: YES — RuleMatrixEngine.evaluate_pre_trade_entry() at signals/rule_matrix.py:491-551 operates as an INDEPENDENT strategy layer. It evaluates raw market microstructure signals (FVG sniper fill, Judas swing fade, order block tap, wick absorption, flash momentum, OFI reversal, news spike, etc.) with hardcoded confidences (0.80-0.95) and returns TradeProposals WITHOUT consulting model probabilities at all. When a rule fires, it REPLACES the policy proposal entirely (policy.py:975-1002 returns rule_proposal.model_copy(..., model_action=rule_proposal.action.value)). RuleMatrix entries bypass the model confidence gate entirely.

findings.topic: Model can trade independently of strategy
findings.finding: NO — the model cannot trade independently. Model inference output (probs from InferenceService.infer_probabilities) flows ONLY through SignalPolicy.evaluate_probabilities, which ALWAYS runs the full strategy gate chain (HTF alignment, SR alignment, zone quality, anti-flip, re-entry lockout, confidence gates). The model's directional BUY/SELL must pass every strategy gate to become a proposal. Even high-confidence model BUYs are rejected by HTF_TREND_FILTER or CONFIDENCE_GATE without strategy agreement. SMC_GOD_MODE is the sole bypass, and it still requires strategy-level microstructure confirmation (BOS + OB + sweep + FVG).
evidence: src/nexus_scalp/signals/policy.py:1044-1086 — BUY path: model BUY MUST pass htf_buy_aligned or smc_god_mode_active, then sr_buy_allowed or smc_god_mode_active, then zone quality, then confidence gate

findings.finding: Two override mechanisms exist: (1) RuntimeModeService.set_execution_mode() at runtime_mode.py:63 — operator hot-switch PAPER/SHADOW<->LIVE via UI/CLI, records _mode_override, swaps adapter, triggers cross-mode invalidation. findings.finding: Order authority flows through a strict chain: SignalPolicy -> DecisionExecutor -> OrderLifecycleManager.dispatch_order() (execution/lifecycle/dispatch.py:227) -> mt5_adapter.execute_market_order() or place_pending_order(). RiskEngine.evaluate_proposal() MUST return non-None before dispatch (kill switch, circuit breakers, spread gate, RR gate, stops-level, max exposure). DispatchEngine.execute_order() (hedge path) also checks kill switch + SAFE_MODE + idempotency. DirectMT5Adapter.send_order() -> mt5.order_send() is the final broker call. HARD_MAX_LOTS=10.0 clamp is applied at dispatch time regardless of RiskEngine sizing.

findings.topic: Execution assumptions and parity (paper vs live)
findings.finding: Paper adapter simulates fills with: (1) deterministic slippage (adverse only, seed-based), (2) auto-SL/TP execution on every tick (broker-managed stops), (3) spread 8-18c gold band (NOT the legacy 25-45c that blocked 100% of fills), (4) BUY fills at ask, SELL at bid. Live/Direct MT5 uses real broker order_send with retcode translation, freeze/stop level guards, and dynamic filling mode resolution. Paper parity check exists at src/nexus_scalp/risk/paper_parity.py. SHADOW mode uses the SAME live adapter as LIVE (only no-mutation boundary differs). Critical assumption: paper tick seed price = 2000.00 (metals), which caused the BUG-231 production incident when stale paper bars crossed to LIVE mode.

findings.topic: Risk engine gate before order dispatch
findings.finding: Every primary entry and hedge must pass RiskEngine.evaluate_proposal() before dispatch. RiskEngine returns None (rejected) on: kill switch active, circuit breaker not allowed, NO_TRADE/WAIT action, max concurrent positions exceeded, max pending orders exceeded, conflicting exposure with limit orders, RR below threshold (min 1.8 default, 1.2 high-confidence), spread exceeds max_spread_points, stops-level violation, SL/TP too close. Hedge path and AI reversal both call evaluate_proposal; AI reversal returns None -> close-only (no flip). Primary entry dispatch at decision_executor.py:252-265 also fails closed on risk_order is None.

The 70D model (scalp_v3/70D with Base 0..49 + News 50..59 + Liquidity 60..69) coexists as a shadow/challenger OR as the champion when a validated 70D artifact is loaded. The effective_feature_dim/schema_id are bundle-authoritative (CHG-0046 D1), never class bootstrap constants.
